theorems.name: Submission.vector_field_eq_zero_of_integral_inner_test_fields
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Rn N)) (M U : Set (Rn N)) (F : Rn N → Rn N), MeasurableSet M → IsOpen U → ContinuousOn F M → (∀ y ∈ M, ∀ O : Set (Rn N), IsOpen O → y ∈ O → 0 < μ (M ∩ O)) → (∀ y ∈ M, ∀ O : Set (Rn N), IsOpen O → y ∈ O → ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ closedBall y ρ ⊆ O ∧ IsCompact (M ∩ closedBall y ρ)) → (∀ Y : Rn N → Rn N, ContDiff ℝ 2 Y → HasCompactSupport Y → tsupport Y ⊆ U → IsCompact (M ∩ tsupport Y) → IntegrableOn (fun y ↦ inner ℝ (Y y) (F y)) M μ ∧ ∫ y in M, inner ℝ (Y y) (F y) ∂μ = 0) → ∀ y ∈ M ∩ U, F y = 0
